summary: Unidentified paddleboarder fell off his board on Corn Lake near Grand Junction around 8 p.m. Saturday and never resurfaced; CPW rangers and Mesa County deputies launched a search that became a recovery mission, and CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team located the body via sonar around 2 a.m. Sunday in about 7.5 ft of water; victim was not wearing a life jacket.
location: Corn Lake, James M. Robb - Colorado River State Park
responding_agency: Colorado Parks and Wildlife rangers; Mesa County Sheriff Office; CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team
notes: Identity unreleased as of 2022-09-12 (FOX 31/iHeart). CPR 2022-11-25 drownings roundup refers to this as a late-October Corn Lake paddleboarder death - appears to be the same incident, misdated there. Date recorded at incident evening 2022-09-10 (Saturday); body recovered 2022-09-11.
